The dog is a bone rig drawn as one ink line over flat fills: 25 bones, IK legs that keep their lengths,
six Smart-Bone corrective actions (neck-turn, spine-curl, leg-fold hind and fore, head-down, jaw-rest),
and a head switch layer with five drawings (profile, three-quarter front, front, three-quarter back, back)
chosen by a view-control bone. It turns its back through the front view and turns back through the back view,
head first; it looks in with the back of its head toward us.
Everything was drawn in code here: dog, person, door, porch, dusk. No photographs, no footage, no doodles.
The voice, paws, door and crickets are synthesized. Its choices follow the PAELEO threshold score.
Not Moho itself: a Moho-style rig written in JavaScript, rendered in Chromium, encoded with ffmpeg.
